title: Career roadmap · Ayush Research Officer
summary: Build a research career in yoga, naturopathy and AYUSH through rigorous study design, clinical or community research, evidence synthesis, publication, programme evaluation and public-sector research.

facts.Current degree: Ph.D. - Physical Education, Sports Science & Yoga
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes the Ph.D. starts in 2026 and the target is an Indian research or public-sector career, with possible progression into AYUSH institutions, universities, research centres, hospitals, public-health programmes and international complementary/integrative-health research.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Complete the Ph.D., build strong research-methods capability, generate publishable evidence and gain experience in AYUSH/yoga/naturopathy research.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Establish a recognised research niche such as yoga interventions, naturopathy, lifestyle disorders, mental health, public health or evidence synthesis.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead multidisciplinary studies, research teams, funded projects and evidence-to-policy programmes.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Become a senior AYUSH research leader influencing research agendas, clinical evidence, public programmes and research policy.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from conducting individual studies to leading research programmes. Build expertise in reproducibility, clinical research, implementation science, health economics, digital health and evidence translation while maintaining a clear AYUSH research identity.
At Ph.D. level, research fellowships, project positions and research-assistant appointments are generally more useful than conventional internships.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Research Fellow/Research Associate
2030–2035: AYUSH Research Officer → Research Scientist → Senior Researcher
2035–2040: Senior Research Officer → Principal Investigator/Research Programme Lead
2040–2046: Senior AYUSH Research Leader → Research Centre Director / National Research Programme Leader
Ph.D. research routes

The senior research path should progress from individual studies to leadership of multidisciplinary research programmes. Build a record of high-quality publications, competitive funding, robust research governance, reproducible data, meaningful collaborations and evidence that research findings were translated into clinical practice or public programmes. International collaboration can strengthen the profile, but methodological quality and credible evidence should remain the core of the career.
